item.title: Muroki Returns Home with Amber Skies
item.description: One of Aotearoa’s most distinctive young voices, Muroki returns home with his long-awaited debut album Amber Skies, out 30 January 2026. Written and recorded while living nomadically between Berlin, Raglan, Portugal and Kenya, Amber Skies captures Muroki’s drive for freedom, new experiences and connection.
